_doc: Single machine-readable source of truth for Medo's reel studio. Human version: brand/BRAND.md. Palette v2 (2026-11-01, given by Medo) replaces the old red/black/white set. Values under `derived` are computed from palette colours and are declared here on purpose — do not invent any other colour.

brand.name: Kodo Medo
brand.name_status: archived working name — never put any name on screen (studio, not a series)
brand.logo_rule: NONE. This is a reel studio, not a named series: no logo, no series name, no episode number, no descriptive chip, no reserved empty circle. Never ask for these; never invent them. End cards are typographic only.

red.role: primary: the big circle, key words, borders, CTA

red_bright.role: strongest red: emphasis, problem state (LIGHT backgrounds only)

red_deep.role: deep red: depth, hover/pressed, shadow side of red shapes

ink.role: dark base = text on light, device bodies, caption plate

ink_soft.role: muted brown: secondary text (large only), screen bars, dividers

paper.role: warm white: text on dark, light background top

gray_1.role: light background bottom, card fills on light

salmon.role: warm accent: numbers/keywords on DARK, glow, warm skin

blush.role: soft accent: highlight chips, light skin, decorative

backgrounds.rule: alternate light/dark per scene; every scene has a different grid cell size/speed/direction; 30 dust particles

contrast_rules: Body text >= 4.5:1 against its real background
Never red text on a dark background (2.0:1) — use salmon there
Never gray_4 or salmon for body-size text

typography.temp_fallback: DejaVu Sans Bold ONLY if declared as temporary in the delivery
typography.rules: whole words only, RTL, raqm layout (direction='rtl', language='ar'); never arabic_reshaper/python-bidi with Pillow

keyword_colours.problem: red on light / salmon on dark
keyword_colours.positive: paper (white) + check glyph — the palette has no green

character.presenter: Medo (anime-style, uploaded poses: wave / think / point)
character.background_disc: red circle 80-95% of canvas width behind hero + ground shadow
character.motion: bob + tilt +/-1.6 deg + sparkles; do not promise hand animation
character.logo_persona: faceless black backlit silhouette: voluminous curly hair, round mirrored glasses (white lenses), dark blazer + collared shirt, light gradient background (LOGO only; presenter on screen is the anime Medo)

skin.note: the two skin tones are part of the palette; do not invent others

motion.transition: red wipe with white edge, 0.4s at scene boundaries

audio.music: Am-F-C-G, 76 BPM, ducked 62% under VO, level ~0.17x
audio.tts_rule: at least 2 rounds (4 voice profiles), Medo picks; then ONE voice + ONE fixed atempo 1.15-1.22x

export.duration: = VO duration, measured with tools/vo_length.py — no target length exists

vibe.priority: detail quality and strong identity over showiness
references: philosopher quote-card series with red geometric shapes

ink_shadow.role: computed: ink darkened 35% — outlines, device screens, dark gradient bottom

palette_notes: There is no green and no yellow in palette v2. Positive emphasis = paper white + a check glyph.
If a video needs a colour outside this palette, stop and ask Medo; do not approximate it.
On DARK backgrounds red carries only ~2.0:1 — use salmon #D97F68 for red-family keywords there.

devices.note: replaces the old dark-green screen + teal bars + yellow dot signature
